pages.text: Moonlight stretched across the sea. Dad took them fishing at night.
They wanted to catch a fish themselves. "Today I will catch one for sure."
Lolo jerked the fishing rod up. Riri stared at her float. "Check whether one has bitten." "Wait quietly."
Lolo lifted the rod again. There was no bait on the hook.
Lolo added fresh bait and lifted it again. Once more, only the bare hook dangled.
Riri did not take her eyes off the float. It shone white in the moonlight.
Riri's eyelids slowly closed. Hugging her rod, she nodded off.
Riri's float slipped under the water. "A bite!" Lolo shouted.
Riri opened her eyes wide. They pulled the rod together.
A silver fish came up, flapping. Dad put it in a bucket. Beside it, Riri was nodding off again.
